text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, toward the end of summer 
training camp—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so glad to see that the training camp 
was a fulfilling experience for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to go, unlike me. I just can't 
wait to show the world our running in the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, she's on fire! I don't think I've 
ever seen Cure burning so brightly before.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm. I'm suuuuper sorry to interrupt 
while everyone's so hyped up, but..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...? What is it, Lapis?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, uhm... I'm thinking... I might... 
just skip running in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!? Don't tell me she's not feeling 
well somewhere...?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, it's not like that! Actually...—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
“—While trying out all sorts of things to 
level up during training camp, something 
crossed my mind, you know?”

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, maybe I'm actually better suited 
for dirt?" ...Kind of like that.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Remember how earlier this year, I just 
happened to get a chance to run a race on 
dirt by myself?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...You mean that time when the snowfall 
caused all the turf races that day to be 
switched to dirt, right?"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Ever since I totally crushed that 
race, I've actually been kind of curious 
about dirt—"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
During the camp, I started vaguely feeling 
like, 'Long distances are actually really 
tough...'

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
In that case, maybe I could just go all 
out and test my strength in a dirt race—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but of course I'll still run the 
Kikuka Sho prep race we planned for late 
summer! Just, you know... to explore the 
possibilities, like...—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should just call it off after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Because, all the fans are expecting me to 
run in the Kikuka Sho together with 
Waltz-chan and the others..."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"If I try switching to dirt at a time like 
this, people might just think... I'm 
running away—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—That's not true at all. Isn't it actually 
the opposite?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I think it's totally fine! Even if Lapis 
runs on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Bubble—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You know, I think Umamusume should give 
their all in the place where they believe 
they're the strongest. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"What Lapis did wasn't running away. It 
was a positive challenge in pursuit of her 
ultimate strength."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Besides, look, just think about it! If 
Lapis makes a name for herself on dirt, 
the Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind will 
spread all the way to dirt too!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's blaze trails outside the Triple 
Crown together, Lapis and me!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
B——Bubbl-chaaaaan!!!! I loooove that about 
you sooo muuuch! Thaaank yooouuu!!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, Bubble is right. Lapis just needs 
to run in her own way from now on.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if we run in different places, 
we are the Four Heavenly Kings. That will 
never change.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you, eve-everyo-oneâ¦â¦ 
*sniff*â¦â¦ To be honestâ¦â¦ I was so 
scaredââ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—S-So you won't be going to the Kikuka 
Sho, but focusing solely on dirt races 
instead...?!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's not like I'm switching completely 
to dirt, more like wielding two blades? 
Wielding both styles, you know? Running on 
that side and doing my best on this side, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
And eventually, the plan is to aim for Sol 
Lapis, one of the 'Four Heavenly Kings,' 
excelling on both dirt and turf!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
There seem to be many fans hoping for a 
clash between the Four Heavenly Kings at 
the Kikuka Sho, but what are your thoughts 
on that?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... True, only two of us made it to the 
Kikuka Sho, but we're gonna keep on 
running, so—

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure everyone will definitely gather 
together again! So please look forward to 
that time!"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, I wrapped it up with such an 
amazing comment, so what is this?! Hey 
everyone, look at this!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see—'Sol Lapis shifting focus is a 
real shame. With how thrilling the Derby 
was, I was really looking forward to the 
Kikuka Sho'—"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"'There is no doubt that the Four Heavenly 
Kings are all formidable. However, 
compared to Sakura Laurel and Mayano Top 
Gun, who stand at the center of the 
current era'—"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
...... "There is no denying that each 
individual impression feels somewhat 
minor."

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...'On the other hand, it's true that the 
Four Heavenly Kings' races carry their 
true heat and excitement only when all 
four of them are present.'—"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"The fans must surely have looked forward 
to their Kikuka Sho in that sense as 
well." ...This is certainly harsh.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
I mean, what do you mean by 'small fry'!? 
Are we worthless unless every single one 
of us is here!?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...Calm down, Lapis. I'm sure not 
everyone is saying things like that."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Waltz is right, Lapis. Sure, what was said 
was pretty shocking, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Let's flip the script and show them from 
right here! We'll each take our own paths 
and shake up the racing world with our 
performances—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Like saying, "Take that! Call that 
pint-sized?!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, you're right. Bubble has a 
point. Taking them down a peg is exactly 
what we should do.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
All right~, just you watch! I'm totally 
gonna tear it up on the dirt track!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, that's the spirit, Lapis!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, let's hype 
ourselves up! Cure-chan, let's go buy ice 
cream at the convenience store!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous, we have an early 
morning tomorrow. I'm brushing my teeth 
and going to bed.

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? This is where you're supposed to 
play along, right!? You're so cold~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The night breeze feels so 
nice...—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: —Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Waltz! Hey, the stars are so clear 
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
......Thanks for just now, and for earlier 
at the barbecue. For cheering everyone up, 
I mean.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It's nothing worth thanking me over.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Fufu— ...You're always like this.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Taking a step ahead while I hesitate. 
Putting it into words before I finish 
thinking—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Just like that, I... we are always being 
saved by you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Right person for the 
right job. I'm just a little more 
impatient than everyone else, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Part of it is also just that I want to do 
it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want to stand at the front of everyone, 
and carve out a path, a future for 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want to be that kind of 'point man' for 
the Four Heavenly Kings. ...I'm proud of 
this title.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Bubble—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...That said, I'll be leaving the autumn 
races to Waltz and the others first. After 
all, the Kikuka Sho takes place earlier.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Still, if Waltz and the others perform 
well in the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"And following that, if I can win the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) and forge a new kind of 
strength, different from claiming the 
Classic Triple Crown—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you can prove it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Even if all 'Four Heavenly Kings' aren't 
together, they can still whip up a storm 
on their own separate paths!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...Our 'vanguard captain' is truly 
dependable, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, count on me from now on too. In 
return, I'll count on you for the things I 
can't do, Waltz.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Working hard alongside everyone is what 
gives me the courage to take on new 
challenges.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I hope you won't forget that.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
It's the reverse of how it usually goes, 
but... I'll definitely pass the baton to 
you from the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
So Bubble, too... Good luck in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), okay?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"If we manage to win both the Kikuka Sho 
and the Tenno Sho (Autumn), let's throw a 
huge victory party! We'll spread out a ton 
of sweets!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh Bubble. Still... that sounds 
wonderful. Let us definitely do that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's a deal! It's a promise, 
Waltz!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: "Yes. ............It's a promise."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so summer camp came to an end, and 
one day, a short while after returning to 
Tracen Academy with Bubble Gum Fellow...

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“—Heading into the autumn season, we've 
interviewed the top contender Umamusume 
who are drawing massive attention from 
race fans! Let's roll the tape!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn), right? Yes! I'm 
completely ready.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I do intend to aim for... back-to-back 
spring and autumn victories.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! This time, aside from her rival 
Mayano Top Gun, there are also challengers 
from the Classic class—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You mean Bubble-chan, right? ...I think 
she has incredible potential.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I intend to face 
them head-on, putting every moment of my 
life up until now on the line!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—A rival I'm keeping an eye on? As far as 
Maya's concerned, it's gotta be Laurel-san 
first, right~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Also, Mave-chin's been amazing lately too! 
Sparks are definitely gonna fly at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! I really think 
Bubble-san is indispensable!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, even you are wary of Bubble-san, 
Mayano-san...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Of cooourse!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You know... Her running just sends chills 
down my spine! Like there's no end to her 
bottomless depth—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Marvelous Sunday, you've been on an 
unstoppable streak lately! What are your 
honest thoughts going into the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh☆ Ev~eryone is so very 
Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Me, Laurel, Mayano... all of us are trying 
to reach for what's "next"☆ And that's 
just so marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I-I see...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's not all. There's a girl 
right now who's super marvelous, trying to 
unleash her own marvelousness☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's Bubble for you! I've been looking 
forward to running with Bubble so, so 
much☆

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—As we can see, Bubble Gum Fellow's entry 
into the Tenno Sho (Autumn) has put 
top-tier Umamusume on high alert—”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haha! Man, that really makes me happy.
choice_data_list:
…Looks like it's going to attract a lot of 
attention.

…Looks like it's going to attract a lot of 
attention

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just what you wanted anyway?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because that way, we can prove our 
strength to so many more people!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Time is limited until the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Let's get fired up and give it 
our all today too!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fateful showdown, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), was right around the corner—
